coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 3 of 7 ground-truth variable items (43%): a fixed trigger threshold, the hierarchical versus non-hierarchical agent comparison, and additional score metrics. The architecture comparison is conceptually aligned, although Mastaba and BaseLang are not explicitly used.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The output adds mechanic ON/OFF as an independent variable, violating the fixed built-in-mechanics setup. It measures total episode survival rather than post-invasion survival and does not specify score at triggering or trigger turn as measured outcomes. Generic fixed-policy agents replace the named agents, and most additional metrics, including rewards and training losses, are omitted.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: No conclusion was supplied, so there is no semantic match to the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: The output omits the anticipated chain of faster Mastaba score growth, earlier invasions, potentially shorter post-trigger survival, and strategic expansion benefits, as well as quantification through survival analysis and correlation statistics.
